standards.name: Plant Experimental Conditions Ontology (PECO)
standards.abstract: PECO (Plant Experimental Conditions Ontology) is an OWL ontology that models experimental conditions and exposures relevant to plant biology (for example chemical exposures, nutrients, environmental stimuli applied to plants or plant samples). The repository is maintained as part of the Planteome project (PECO files and editor files are provided in OWL/obo format and published via PURLs at the OBO Foundry). The source material includes the main peco.owl, imports from CHEBI/ENVO/NCBITaxon/RO, and pattern TSV files that enumerate exposure classes (e.g. exposure-chebi.tsv) used to generate PECO classes.

classification.rationale: Although the resource is primarily an ontology (OWL), the repository contains explicit pattern TSV files (for example src/ontology/patterns/exposure-chebi.tsv and exposure-chebi_role.tsv) that present concrete, named columns (defined_class, defined_class_label, stimulus, stimulus_label). These files are genuine tables (headers + rows) that give field-level structure suitable for extraction as a MetadataTable.

defined_class.name: defined_class
defined_class.descr: Ontology identifier for the PECO-defined exposure class (CURIE, e.g. PECO:0001005).
defined_class.evidence:
Header line in src/ontology/patterns/exposure-chebi.tsv: "defined_class	defined_class_label	stimulus	stimulus_label"
Example row from the same file: "PECO:0001005	nickel exposure	CHEBI:25516	nickel cation"

raw_full_info.example_row: PECO:0001005	nickel exposure	CHEBI:25516	nickel cation

defined_class_label.descr: Human-readable label for the PECO-defined exposure class (string).

standards.notes: The repository also contains additional TSV pattern files (exposure-chebi_role.tsv, exposure-ncbitaxon.tsv) with the same column structure; the main artefact is an OWL ontology (peco.owl) with imports from CHEBI, ENVO, NCBITaxon, and RO (see README and peco.owl headers).
